items.exampleEn: A lion is a big animal.
My dog likes to run in the park.
It is cold today. Wear a coat.
We swim in the sea in summer.
The wind is very strong today.
A bird is singing in the tree.

items.audioEn: It is too cold to swim in the sea today.
items.audioZh: 今天太冷了，不能在海裡游泳。
items.questionZh: 為什麼今天不能去海裡游泳？

items.sentenceEn: The dog is afraid of the wind.

items.stemEn: Look at the ____! It is very blue.
Put on your coat. It is ____ outside.

items.passageEn: Today we go to the sea. The sky is blue, and the sun is hot. There is a strong wind, so we fly a kite. We see many birds over the water. Our dog runs on the beach. In the evening, it gets cold, so we go home.
items.passageZh: 今天我們去海邊。天空很藍，太陽很大。風很強，所以我們去放風箏。我們看到很多鳥在海面上飛。我們的狗在沙灘上跑。到了傍晚，天氣變冷，我們就回家了。

referenceEn: It is cold outside, and the wind is strong.
It's very cold outside, and there is a strong wind.
rubricZh: 說天氣冷可用 It is cold
「風很大」可用 the wind is strong、there is a strong wind、It is windy 等

items.instructionZh: 用 animal 造一個句子，說說你最喜歡的動物。
referenceEn: My favorite animal is the cat.
I love dogs. They are my favorite animals.
rubricZh: 「最喜歡的動物」可用 my favorite animal
泛指動物可用複數（例如 animals、dogs）
